title: …as the waves at twilight… (Miniature IV for solo violin)
program_note: ...as the waves at twilight... (Minia­ture IV for Violin) was written in 1992, and is meant to be played as an in­ner, private dialogue, between two parts of the same self, exploring the possibilities of two-line poly­phony in solo violin playing, resulting in a work that features the minor thirds typical of much minimalist music, with much more harmonic ac­tivity.  It is highly demanding, exhibiting a “quiet virtuosity.”
